metadata.question: Was surface water extent higher on February 25, 2019 as compared to February 27, 2014 in the Mississippi River near the Memphis, Tennesse?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: Need to compare water extent between two specific dates (Feb 25, 2019 vs Feb 27, 2014) in the Mississippi River near Memphis, Tennessee. I'll use Sentinel-2 for good water detection capability. 2. Masking strategy: Need to mask clouds to get clear water detection. Will use the QA60 band for cloud masking. 3. Logic: Use NDWI (Normalized Difference Water Index) to detect water, then calculate water extent for each date and compare. 4. Data quality checks: - Check if collections have images for both dates - Check if valid pixels exist after cloud masking - Validate the water extent calculations For water detection, I'll use NDWI = (Green - NIR) / (Green + NIR) where values > 0 typically indicate water. Let me define the geometry around Memphis, Tennessee near the Mississippi River. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const memphis = ee.Geometry.Point([-90.0489, 35.1495]); // Memphis, TN coordinates const riverBuffer = memphis.buffer(5000); // 5km buffer around Memphis to capture Mississippi River // Date ranges (single day for each comparison) const date2014 = '2014-02-27'; const date2019 = '2019-02-25'; // 2. Data Acquisition - Sentinel-2 for water detection const s2_2014 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(riverBuffer) .filterDate(date2014, '2014-02-28'); const s2_2019 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(riverBuffer) .filterDate(date2019, '2019-02-26'); // Check collection sizes const count2014 = s2_2014.size().getInfo(); const count2019 = s2_2019.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2014 Images: ${count2014}, 2019 Images: ${count2019}`); if (count2014 === 0 || count2019 === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // Get least cloudy image for each date const img2014 = s2_2014.sort('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE').first(); const img2019 = s2_2019.sort('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE').first(); // Cloud masking function function maskClouds(image) { const qa = image.select('QA60'); const cloudBitMask = 1 << 10; const cirrusBitMask = 1 << 11; const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBitMask).eq(0) .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(cirrusBitMask).eq(0)); return image.updateMask(mask); } const img2014_masked = maskClouds(img2014); const img2019_masked = maskClouds(img2019); // Calculate NDWI for water detection (Green - NIR) / (Green + NIR) function addNDWI(image) { const ndwi = image.normalizedDifference(['B3', 'B8']).rename('NDWI'); return image.addBands(ndwi); } const img2014_ndwi = addNDWI(img2014_masked); const img2019_ndwi = addNDWI(img2019_masked); // Check valid pixel counts const count2014_valid = img2014_ndwi.select('NDWI').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: riverBuffer, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDWI').getInfo(); const count2019_valid = img2019_ndwi.select('NDWI').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: riverBuffer, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDWI').getInfo(); console.log(`Valid pixels 2014: ${count2014_valid}, 2019: ${count2019_valid}`); if (count2014_valid === 0 || count2019_valid === 0) { console.log("C2"); return; } // Calculate water extent (NDWI > 0 indicates water) const water2014 = img2014_ndwi.select('NDWI').gt(0); const water2019 = img2019_ndwi.select('NDWI').gt(0); const waterArea2014 = water2014.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: riverBuffer, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDWI').getInfo(); const waterArea2019 = water2019.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: riverBuffer, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDWI').getInfo(); console.log(`Water area 2014: ${waterArea2014}, 2019: ${waterArea2019}`); // Validation check if (waterArea2014 === null || waterArea2019 === null || isNaN(waterArea2014) || isNaN(waterArea2019)) { console.log("C3"); return; } // Final comparison if (waterArea2019 > waterArea2014) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
